text:
amy (partnerships): FYI we kicked off an Embedded SDK connector pilot with VectorMesh (they're an SI + HW reseller). want to align on sandbox, SSO, and marketplace listing timing.
raj (eng-platform): great — what's the sandbox req? GPU access or just API keys?
amy (partnerships): need a small dedicated GPU pool to exercise quantized runner + KV cache. want realistic perf numbers for their demo flow (~512 tokens, batch=1-4).
noah (product): agree on perf. also need to lock API contract for the connector so their engineers can code against it. we should publish a simple spec + quickstart.
kate (devex): I can draft quickstart and sample app. can someone paste the minimal config? would prefer a docker-based example.
raj (eng-platform): here's a minimal env snippet we used in previous pilots:
```
REDWOOD_API_KEY=redacted
REDWOOD_MODEL=redwood-v1-quantized
BATCH_SIZE=2
KV_CACHE_ENABLED=true
```
mike (solutions): VectorMesh asked about SSO for their sandbox users (SAML) and a marketplace SKU for dedicated capacity discounts. SLA questions too.
amy (partnerships): SSO is doable but needs entitlements from our private deploy team. @raj can you estimate hookup time?
raj (eng-platform): SAML integration + test users ~ 2-3 weeks if we have their IdP metadata. Dedicated SKU + pricing calc needs sales input.
noah (product): Marketing/announce ask: they want a co-announcement 2 weeks after pilot signoff. we need an embargo window and a joint demo script.
kate (devex): demo script = 2 flows: 1) low-latency question answering on customer docs, 2) agent flow that calls a gateway for llm ops. I can shepherd SDK samples for both.
mike (solutions): they requested a private cloud marketplace listing in AWS Marketplace and a hardware bundle note (GPU sku + support hours). who's owning marketplace onboarding?
amy (partnerships): I'll lead marketplace comms. action items: 1) @mike collect VectorMesh IdP + demo user list (today) 2) @raj confirm sandbox infra and timeline (EOW) 3) @kate quickstart + sample app (next Tue) 4) @noah draft embargo + co-announcement checklist (next Wed). can we hit pilot in 3 weeks?
raj (eng-platform): tentative yes, assuming no surprises on IdP. I'll start provisioning a `pilot-vm` pool and share access.
noah (product): I'll add the embargo items: legal signoff, joint quote approval, two technical signoffs (eng + devex).
amy (partnerships): also note: VectorMesh asked about a prebuilt LangChain/LLamaIndex adapter. we should provide a starter connector repo.
kate (devex): I'll scaffold a repo and include a quick LangChain example using our SDK. will include README + test harness.
amy (partnerships): perfect. one more ask from them: a performance note about quantized vs full fp16 for the model variants so they can choose in the bundle. @raj any docs we can share?
raj (eng-platform): I'll export an internal perf matrix and redact infra names. share as `perf_summary.md` in the sandbox repo.
mike (solutions): for marketplace pricing, can we offer a 3-month pilot discount? i'll ping sales/legal after this thread.
announce-bot: Reminder: please set the co-announcement embargo date in the partnership tracker when agreed: https://internal/redwood/partnerships/tracker
amy (partnerships): thanks everyone. i'll consolidate tasks into the tracker and ping VectorMesh for IdP metadata. :thumbsup:
